summary: No single open table of species pairs crossed in both directions was confirmed. Open, CC0 datasets exist for individual systems (89 seed-plant taxa pairs, Drosophila species pairs, population crosses in a fish and a plant), but I could not read column headers (Dryad anonymous downloads returned 401) and did not verify that each holds per-direction values. The Drosophila dataset's abstract does not mention reciprocal crosses.
next_step: Download RI_data_FINAL.csv and the Turelli CoynOrriginDat CSVs through a browser and check for per-direction columns; if absent, compile reciprocal results from the 70 source publications of the seed-plant set.
obstacles_confirmed: Cross records are decentralised and taxonomically uneven.
Many compilations collapse the two directions into one score (not checkable from metadata alone).
